text:
Elias Pettersson the defenseman (not the center) is 22, a third-round pick from 2022, and playing about 20 minutes a night on Vancouver's blue line. He has three goals and four points in 19 games, with 44 hits, and his ice time has climbed nearly two minutes a night lately.

The goals came quickly and won't keep coming at this rate: three on 1.1 expected, a 17.6% shooting percentage that is more than double what defensemen usually see. They mattered, though. Wins added ranks him 149th of 504 skaters, mostly because his goals swung games.

The defensive picture is the bigger question. Evolving-Hockey's numbers last season had opponents creating more against him than against all but 2% of defensemen, though with teammates in the bottom 5% by impact. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking flags his exits: only 31% keep possession. This season the Canucks are about four points of expected goal share better with him on than off, a good sign. Our range says 12 to 26 points over a full season. The physical game is there; the puck game is the work in progress.
headline: Pettersson on the blue line
